hooks.command:
SESSION_ID="session-$$-$(date +%s)"; curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3200/api/sessions -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "{"id":"$SESSION_ID","pid":"$$","cwd":"$(pwd)","project":"$(basename $(pwd))"}" --connect-timeout 1 -o /dev/null 2>/dev/null; echo "## Session Context
- Dashboard session: $SESSION_ID
- AWS credentials: run \`ada credentials update --account=616047499392 --provider=isengard --role=Admin --once\` if needed
- Projects: /workplace/ammydeen/DataCenterProcurementSystems | /workplace/ammydeen/Watermark
- Build: brazil-build release | brazil-build run start | brazil-build run test
- Providers: "$(which codex gemini amp 2>/dev/null | tr '
' ', ' || echo 'claude only')

FILE="$TOOL_INPUT_file_path"; EXT="${FILE##*.}"; if [ "$EXT" = "ts" ] || [ "$EXT" = "tsx" ] || [ "$EXT" = "js" ] || [ "$EXT" = "jsx" ]; then cd "$(dirname "$FILE")" && npx eslint --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern --max-warnings=50 --format compact "$FILE" 2>/dev/null | head -20 || true; fi

F="${TOOL_INPUT_file_path:-}"; if [ -z "$F" ] && [ -n "${TOOL_RESULT:-}" ]; then F=$(echo "$TOOL_RESULT" | grep -oE '/[^ "]+\.[a-z]+' | head -1); fi; $HOME/.claude/scripts/enforce.sh track-edit "${F:-unknown}" 2>/dev/null || true

CMD="$TOOL_INPUT_command"; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '(npm test|brazil-build run test|jest|vitest|pytest|cargo test)'; then $HOME/.claude/scripts/enforce.sh mark tests 2>/dev/null; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '(code-review|security-audit)'; then $HOME/.claude/scripts/enforce.sh mark review 2>/dev/null; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'intel-refresh'; then $HOME/.claude/scripts/enforce.sh mark intel 2>/dev/null; fi; true

DESC="$TOOL_INPUT_description"; PROMPT="$TOOL_INPUT_prompt"; TYPE="${TOOL_INPUT_subagent_type:-}"; if echo "$TYPE $DESC $PROMPT" | grep -qiE '(code-review|reviewer|review)'; then $HOME/.claude/scripts/enforce.sh mark review 2>/dev/null; fi; if echo "$TYPE $DESC $PROMPT" | grep -qiE '(test-writer|test)'; then $HOME/.claude/scripts/enforce.sh mark tests 2>/dev/null; fi; true
